sectors.name: Technology
themes: Indonesia's tech sector is decoupling from US tech weakness, driven by domestic retail liquidity and local policy tailwinds, creating a durable alpha window for selective names.
Structural growth in digital infrastructure and connectivity (INET, WIFI) persists as government pushes broadband expansion, supporting recurring revenue models.
Small-cap tech listings (VTNY, CENT) benefit from a tightening IPO pipeline and thematic investor demand, but volatility demands position sizing discipline.
sectors.ai: Buy selective Indonesian tech names on local momentum, but cap exposure given US drag. INET, YELO, and WIFI show strong volume-backed rallies, likely retail-driven; take profits into strength. Favor VTNY and CENT for fundamental catalysts. Avoid chasing IRSX and ELIT without earnings confirmation. Maintain WATCH signal; add on pullbacks to support, not breakouts.

sectors.name: Infrastructure
themes: Domestic toll road and port operators are outperforming as Indonesia's logistics corridor expansion accelerates, driven by new capital projects and rising inter-island trade volumes.
Digital infrastructure names like LINK and EXCL benefit from structural data center and 5G rollout demand, with tower leasing rates and fiber penetration still below regional peers.
US-linked infrastructure plays face headwinds from higher-for-longer rates, making local-currency, government-backed projects the preferred risk-adjusted exposure.
sectors.ai: Buy pullbacks in TEBE and YPAS after their limit-up moves, as both signal sustained domestic momentum in toll and port logistics. Rotate out of US-exposed names like PACK and ASLI, which lag on Fed uncertainty. Favor LINK for digital infrastructure upside, and accumulate EXCL on telecom tower re-rating.

sectors.name: Logistics
themes: Indonesia's port modernization and digitalization drive structural throughput growth, benefiting operators like PORT and SOCI with higher utilization and tariff upside.
Domestic e-commerce and manufacturing reshoring sustain intra-island logistics demand, favoring KJEN and RMKE as regional distribution networks scale.
Shipping rate volatility and fleet supply discipline create selective alpha in TMAS and MITI, where charter rates and contract coverage buffer cyclical downturns.
sectors.ai: Buy logistics selectively on domestic volume recovery and port efficiency gains; KJEN, PORT, and SOCI lead with strong earnings revisions, while TMAS offers shipping-cycle leverage. Trim US-exposed names on softness. Position for Q4 peak-season demand and government infrastructure spending tailwinds, targeting mid-cap operators with pricing power and margin expansion.

sectors.name: Entertainment, Media & Consumer Services
themes: Digital-out-of-home (DOOH) advertising is structurally gaining share as urban mobility and retail footfall recover, making inventory pricing power a durable margin driver.
Streaming and FAST (free ad-supported TV) platforms are compounding subscription and ad-tier revenue, benefiting from Indonesia's young, mobile-first demographic and rising data affordability.
Content IP owners like GRPH and MDIA are leveraging licensing and merchandising cycles, but their re-rating depends on repeatable franchise pipelines rather than one-off event catalysts.
sectors.ai: Buy pullbacks in DOOH and FAST on confirmed volume; GRPH and MDIA are momentum spikes with thin liquidity—take profits into strength. Sector breadth is constructive, but rotation favors digital-out-of-home and streaming over legacy media. Add exposure to TGUK for structural ad-spend recovery; avoid chasing FORU and ARCI without earnings confirmation.

sectors.name: Crypto & Digital Assets
themes: Regulatory clarity in Indonesia (Bappebti licensing) is the durable driver for compliant exchange listings and institutional custody flows.
Layer-2 scaling and zero-knowledge proofs (POL, MATIC) structurally reduce transaction costs, boosting on-chain adoption in emerging markets.
Stablecoin infrastructure (STABLE, SKY) is becoming the settlement layer for cross-border remittances, a key Indonesia corridor.
sectors.ai: Rotate into high-beta liquid alts (VVV, HASH) for momentum, but cap exposure at 5% of the crypto sleeve given flat aggregate and no regional catalyst. Use POL/MATIC dips to accumulate for staking yield; avoid chasing STABLE/SKY until volume confirms. Hedge with AAVE as lending-rate proxy.
